blocks.text: O'zbekchada biror joyda nimadir borligini «**bor**» so'zi bilan aytamiz: «Stol ustida kitob **bor**», «Shaharda ko'p bog' **bor**». Ingliz tilida buning uchun **there is** (birlik) va **there are** (ko'plik) ishlatiladi: **There is** a book on the table. **There are** a lot of parks in the city. So'z tartibi o'zbekchaning teskarisi: o'zbekchada — joy + narsa + «bor», inglizchada — **there is** + narsa + joy. Bu yerda **there** «u yerda» degan ma'noni bermaydi — u shunchaki gapni boshlab beradi, chunki inglizcha gapda ega va fe'l doim oldinda turishi kerak.

rows: **There aren't** any banks. / **There are no** banks.

blocks.text: Birlik va sanalmaydigan otlar (milk, water, time) bilan — **there is**, ko'plik bilan — **there are**. So'zlashuvda **there is** deyarli doim qisqaradi: **there's**. **there are** ning yozma qisqa shakli odatda ishlatilmaydi. Bir nechta narsa sanab o'tilsa, fe'l birinchi narsaga qarab tanlanadi: **There's** a bed and two chairs in the room. Qisqa javobda esa qisqartirish bo'lmaydi: Yes, there **is** («Yes, there's» emas).

items.text: **There are** two parks in our district.

blocks.text: Inkor: there isn't / there aren't / there's no

«... yo'q» ikki xil aytiladi. Birinchisi — **there isn't** / **there aren't**: **There isn't** a lift. **There aren't** any shops. Ko'plik va sanalmaydigan otlar bilan inkorda odatda **any** keladi (→ 76-dars, some va any). Ikkinchisi — **there's no** / **there are no** + ot: **There's no** lift. **There are no** shops. Ma'nosi bir xil, **no** biroz kuchliroq eshitiladi. Bitta gapda ikkita inkor bo'lmaydi: «There isn't no ...» xato.

items.text: **There isn't** a supermarket in our village.

blocks.text: Savolda **is / are** oldinga chiqadi: **Is there** ...? **Are there** ...? — «... bormi?». Masalan, notanish shaharda: **Is there** a cash machine near here? — «Bu yerga yaqin bankomat bormi?». Javob: Yes, **there is**. / No, **there isn't**. Miqdorni so'rash: **How many** ... **are there**? — «Nechta ... bor?»: **How many** rooms **are there**? — Three.

items.text: **Is there** a café in the museum? — Yes, **there is**.
**How many** players **are there** in a football team? — Eleven.
items.translation: Futbol jamoasida nechta o'yinchi **bor**? — O'n bitta.

blocks.text: **there is** yangi narsani **tanishtiradi**: tinglovchi u haqda hali bilmaydi. Keyin shu narsa haqida gapirganda **it** ishlatiladi: **There's** a new shop near my house. **It's** very cheap. — «Uyim yaqinida yangi do'kon bor. U juda arzon». «It is a shop near my house» deyish xato — **it** «bor» ma'nosini bermaydi. **it** ning boshqa vazifalari (ob-havo, vaqt, masofa) — 39-darsda.

O'zbekcha «bor» inglizchada ikki xil: **joyda** nimadir bor — **there is**: **There's** a car in the garage. — «Garajda mashina bor». **Kishining** nimasi bor (egalik) — **have got**: I**'ve got** a car. — «Mening mashinam bor» (→ 9-dars). «Tashkent has got a metro» ham, «**There's** a metro in Tashkent» ham to'g'ri.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «In the room is a table.» → **There's a table in the room.**; «There are a book on the desk.» → **There's a book on the desk.**; «There is many people.» → **There are a lot of people.**; «Have there a bank near here?» → **Is there a bank near here?**; «It is a bank near here.» → **There's a bank near here.**; «In my city have many parks.» → **There are many parks in my city.**

Eslab qolish: o'zbekcha «... **bor**» / «... **yo'q**» / «... **bormi**?» ni eshitsangiz — **there is / there isn't / is there**. Ko'plik bo'lsa — **are**. Gapni joy bilan boshlash ham mumkin: In my bag **there's** a book.

rows: **There aren't** any lamps. / **There are no** lamps.

examples.title: **There's** / **There is**: one thing
examples.description: Birlik yoki sanalmaydigan ot bilan — **there is**, so'zlashuvda **there's** = «... bor». Gapni joy bilan ham boshlash mumkin: In the kitchen **there is** ...

sentences.text: **There's** a good restaurant near our hotel.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonamiz yaqinida yaxshi restoran **bor**.

sentences.text: In the kitchen **there is** a big table and six chairs.
sentences.translation: Oshxonada katta stol va oltita stul **bor**.

sentences.text: Look, **there's** a spider on the wall!
sentences.translation: Qara, devorda o'rgimchak **bor**!

sentences.text: **There's** a bus stop opposite the bank.
sentences.translation: Bankning ro'parasida avtobus bekati **bor**.

sentences.text: Near my school **there's** a small park with a lake.
sentences.translation: Maktabim yaqinida ko'lli kichik bog' **bor**.

sentences.text: In Samarkand **there is** a famous square called the Registan.
sentences.translation: Samarqandda Registon degan mashhur maydon **bor**.

sentences.text: Sorry, **there's** a problem with your booking.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, buyurtmangizda muammo **bor**.

sentences.text: I think **there's** some milk in the fridge.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, muzlatgichda ozgina sut **bor**.

sentences.text: On the second floor **there is** a room for meetings.
sentences.translation: Ikkinchi qavatda yig'ilishlar uchun xona **bor**.

sentences.text: Every year **there's** a big music festival in our town.
sentences.translation: Har yili shahrimizda katta musiqa festivali **bo'ladi**.

examples.title: **There are**: more than one
examples.description: Ko'plik bilan — **there are** = «... bor», «... ko'p». Sanoq so'zlari bilan: **there are** four ..., **there are** a lot of ...

sentences.text: **There are** four bedrooms in the new house.
sentences.translation: Yangi uyda to'rtta yotoqxona **bor**.

sentences.text: In our class **there are** twenty-five students.
sentences.translation: Sinfimizda yigirma beshta o'quvchi **bor**.

sentences.text: **There are** a lot of beautiful old buildings in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Buxoroda juda ko'p chiroyli qadimiy binolar **bor**.

sentences.text: Look! **There are** two cats on our roof.
sentences.translation: Qara! Tomimizda ikkita mushuk **bor**.

sentences.text: Today **there are** some cheap flights to London.
sentences.translation: Bugun Londonga bir nechta arzon reys **bor**.

sentences.text: On this street **there are** three cafés and a bakery.
sentences.translation: Bu ko'chada uchta kafe va bitta novvoyxona **bor**.

sentences.text: Be careful — **there are** a lot of cars on the road this morning.
sentences.translation: Ehtiyot bo'ling — bugun ertalab yo'lda mashinalar juda **ko'p**.

sentences.text: In Britain **there are** four countries: England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.
sentences.translation: Britaniyada to'rtta mamlakat **bor**: Angliya, Shotlandiya, Uels va Shimoliy Irlandiya.

sentences.text: At the market **there are** fresh apricots and cherries now.
sentences.translation: Hozir bozorda yangi o'rik va gilos **bor**.

sentences.text: I can't sleep because **there are** mosquitoes in my room.
sentences.translation: Uxlay olmayapman, chunki xonamda chivinlar **bor**.

examples.title: Negative: **there isn't**, **there aren't**, **there's no**
examples.description: «... yo'q»: **there isn't** (birlik), **there aren't** (ko'plik, ko'pincha **any** bilan) yoki **there's no** / **there are no** + ot.

sentences.text: **There isn't** a lift in this building.
sentences.translation: Bu binoda lift **yo'q**.

sentences.text: Sorry, **there aren't** any seats left on the train.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, poyezdda bo'sh joy **qolmadi**.

sentences.text: In my village **there isn't** a cinema.
sentences.translation: Qishlog'imizda kinoteatr **yo'q**.

sentences.text: **There's no** milk — can you buy some on the way home?
sentences.translation: Sut **yo'q** — uyga kelayotib olib kela olasanmi?

sentences.text: **There aren't** many people in the park today.
sentences.translation: Bugun bog'da odam **ko'p emas**.

sentences.text: Don't worry, **there's no** problem.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmang, hech qanday muammo **yo'q**.

sentences.text: On Sundays **there aren't** any buses to the airport.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kunlari aeroportga avtobus **yo'q**.

sentences.text: The room has a TV, but **there isn't** a fridge.
sentences.translation: Xonada televizor bor, lekin muzlatgich **yo'q**.

sentences.text: Madina is upset because **there's no** hot water in the flat.
sentences.translation: Madina xafa, chunki kvartirada issiq suv **yo'q**.

sentences.text: In winter **there aren't** many tourists in Khiva, so the hotels are cheap.
sentences.translation: Qishda Xivada sayyohlar **ko'p bo'lmaydi**, shuning uchun mehmonxonalar arzon.

examples.title: Questions: **Is there** ...? **Are there** ...?
examples.description: «... bormi?»: **Is there** ...? (birlik), **Are there** ...? (ko'plik). Qisqa javob: Yes, **there is**. / No, **there aren't**.

sentences.text: **Is there** a bank near here? — Yes, **there is**. It's next to the post office.
sentences.translation: Bu yerga yaqin bank **bormi**? — Ha, **bor**. Pochta yonida.

sentences.text: **Are there** any good shops in this area? — No, **there aren't**.
sentences.translation: Bu hududda yaxshi do'konlar **bormi**? — Afsuski, **yo'q**.

sentences.text: Excuse me, **is there** a toilet on this floor?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu qavatda hojatxona **bormi**?

sentences.text: **Is there** any bread left? — Yes, **there's** half a loaf.
sentences.translation: Non **qoldimi**? — Ha, yarimta non **bor**.

sentences.text: Mum, **is there** anything to eat? I'm starving!
sentences.translation: Oyi, yeydigan biror narsa **bormi**? Qornim juda och!

sentences.text: **Are there** any trains to Bukhara after nine? — Yes, **there's** one at ten.
sentences.translation: Soat to'qqizdan keyin Buxoroga poyezd **bormi**? — Ha, soat o'nda bitta **bor**.

sentences.text: Tom, **is there** anything good on TV tonight? — No, **there isn't**.
sentences.translation: Tom, bugun kechqurun televizorda yaxshi biror narsa **bormi**? — Yo'q, **hech narsa yo'q**.

sentences.text: In your hotel, **are there** rooms with a balcony?
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonangizda balkonli xonalar **bormi**?

sentences.text: Sorry, **is there** a problem with my visa? — No, everything is fine.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, vizamda biror muammo **bormi**? — Yo'q, hammasi joyida.

sentences.text: Bekzod, **are there** any eggs in the fridge? — Yes, **there are** six.
sentences.translation: Bekzod, muzlatgichda tuxum **bormi**? — Ha, oltita **bor**.

examples.title: **How many** ... **are there**?
examples.description: Miqdorni so'rash: **How many** + ko'plik ot + **are there**? = «Nechta ... bor?». Javobda ko'pincha faqat son yoki **There are** ...

sentences.text: **How many** students **are there** in your group? — **There are** twelve.
sentences.translation: Guruhingizda nechta talaba **bor**? — O'n ikkita.

sentences.text: **How many** days **are there** in February this year?
sentences.translation: Bu yil fevralda necha kun **bor**?

sentences.text: In a week **there are** seven days, and in a year **there are** twelve months.
sentences.translation: Bir haftada yetti kun, bir yilda esa o'n ikki oy **bor**.

sentences.text: Aziz, **how many** people **are there** in your family? — Five.
sentences.translation: Aziz, oilangizda necha kishi **bor**? — Besh kishi.

sentences.text: **There are** about three million people in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda taxminan uch million aholi **bor**.

sentences.text: And the flat? How many rooms **are there**? — Three, plus a kitchen.
sentences.translation: Kvartira-chi? Unda nechta xona **bor**? — Uchta, yana oshxona.

sentences.text: **Is there** one bathroom or two? — **There are** two, actually.
sentences.translation: Hammom bittami yoki ikkita? — Aslida, ikkita **bor**.

sentences.text: Teacher, how many questions **are there** in the test? — Twenty.
sentences.translation: Ustoz, testda nechta savol **bor**? — Yigirmata.

sentences.text: In our office **there are** more women than men.
sentences.translation: Ofisimizda erkaklardan ko'ra ayollar **ko'proq**.

sentences.text: Look at this photo: **there are** five of us, and the little one is me.
sentences.translation: Bu suratga qara: biz **beshtamiz**, kichkinasi — men.

examples.title: **there is** ↔ **it is**
examples.description: **There is** yangi narsani tanishtiradi («... bor»), **it is** esa aytilgan narsa haqida gapiradi («u ...»). Ko'pincha ikkalasi ketma-ket keladi.

sentences.text: **There's** a new café on our street. **It's** very popular.
sentences.translation: Ko'chamizda yangi kafe **bor**. U juda **mashhur**.

sentences.text: Look, **there's** a letter for you. **It's** from London.
sentences.translation: Qara, senga xat **bor**. U **Londondan**.

sentences.text: Near the station **there's** a big hotel, but **it's** very expensive.
sentences.translation: Vokzal yaqinida katta mehmonxona **bor**, lekin u juda **qimmat**.

sentences.text: **It's** a beautiful city, and **there are** lots of museums.
sentences.translation: U go'zal **shahar**, unda juda ko'p muzey **bor**.

sentences.text: What's that noise? — **There's** a cat in the garden. **It's** hungry, I think.
sentences.translation: Bu qanday shovqin? — Bog'da mushuk **bor**. Qorni **och** shekilli.

sentences.text: In my bag **there's** a present for Dilnoza. **It's** a scarf.
sentences.translation: Sumkamda Dilnoza uchun sovg'a **bor**. Bu **sharf**.

sentences.text: **It's** cold today, and **there's** snow on the mountains.
sentences.translation: Bugun **sovuq**, tog'larda qor **bor**.

sentences.text: We've got a problem: **there's** water on the floor, and **it's** coming from the kitchen.
sentences.translation: Muammo chiqdi: polda suv **bor**, u oshxonadan **oqib kelyapti**.

sentences.text: **There's** a film on TV tonight. **It's** about a family in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun televizorda film **bor**. U Samarqanddagi bir oila **haqida**.

sentences.text: **Is there** a pharmacy near here? — Yes, **it's** just round the corner.
sentences.translation: Yaqin atrofda dorixona **bormi**? — Ha, **u** shundoq burchakda.

examples.title: Two kinds of «bor»: **there is** ↔ **have got**
examples.description: O'zbekcha «bor» inglizchada ikki xil: joyda nimadir bor — **there is / are**, kimningdir nimasi bor (egalik) — **have got / has got** (→ 9-dars).

sentences.text: I**'ve got** a car, and **there's** a garage behind our house.
sentences.translation: Mening mashinam **bor**, uyimiz orqasida esa garaj **bor**.

sentences.text: Aziz **has got** a big family — eight people live in his house.
sentences.translation: Azizning katta oilasi **bor** — uyida sakkiz kishi yashaydi.

sentences.text: **There's** a swimming pool in our hotel.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonamizda basseyn **bor**.

sentences.text: Our hotel **has got** a swimming pool and a gym.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonamizda basseyn va sport zali **bor**.

sentences.text: Have you **got** a pen? — Sorry, no. But **there are** some pencils on the desk.
sentences.translation: Ruchkangiz **bormi**? — Kechirasiz, yo'q. Lekin stol ustida qalamlar **bor**.

sentences.text: Madina **hasn't got** any free time this week.
sentences.translation: Madinaning bu hafta umuman bo'sh vaqti **yo'q**.

sentences.text: In the fridge **there isn't** any meat, so let's make vegetable soup.
sentences.translation: Muzlatgichda go'sht **yo'q**, shuning uchun sabzavotli sho'rva qilaylik.

sentences.text: Tashkent **has got** a metro, but Bukhara **hasn't**.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda metro **bor**, Buxoroda esa **yo'q**.

sentences.text: My phone **has got** a good camera, but **there isn't** much space for photos.
sentences.translation: Telefonimda yaxshi kamera **bor**, lekin suratlar uchun joy **kam**.

sentences.text: Sarah **hasn't got** a garden, but **there's** a lovely park opposite her flat.
sentences.translation: Saraning bog'i **yo'q**, lekin kvartirasining ro'parasida ajoyib bog' **bor**.

examples.title: Dialogue: asking about a flat
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ijaraga kvartira haqida telefon suhbati — **Is there** ...?, **Are there** ...?, **How many** ...?, qisqa javoblar va **there's no** ...

sentences.text: — Good morning. I'm calling about the flat on King Street. **Is there** a lift in the building?
sentences.translation: — Xayrli tong. King ko'chasidagi kvartira bo'yicha qo'ng'iroq qilyapman. Binoda lift **bormi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, **there is**, and **there's** also a car park behind the building.
sentences.translation: — Ha, **bor**, bino orqasida avtoturargoh ham **bor**.

sentences.text: — Great. How many bedrooms **are there**?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. Nechta yotoqxona **bor**?

sentences.text: — **There are** two bedrooms and a small study.
sentences.translation: — Ikkita yotoqxona va kichik ish xonasi **bor**.

sentences.text: — And **is there** a washing machine in the kitchen?
sentences.translation: — Oshxonada kir yuvish mashinasi **bormi**?

sentences.text: — No, **there isn't**, but **there's** a laundry room downstairs.
sentences.translation: — Afsuski, **yo'q**, lekin pastki qavatda kir yuvish xonasi **bor**.

sentences.text: — OK. **Are there** any shops nearby?
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi. Yaqin atrofda do'konlar **bormi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, **there's** a supermarket opposite, and **there are** two cafés on the corner.
sentences.translation: — Ha, ro'parada supermarket, burchakda esa ikkita kafe **bor**.

sentences.text: — It sounds perfect. **Is there** a good time to see it?
sentences.translation: — Juda yaxshi ekan. Uni ko'rish uchun qulay vaqt **bormi**?

sentences.text: — Of course. The flat is empty, so **there's no** problem — come at three.
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Kvartira bo'sh, shuning uchun hech qanday muammo **yo'q** — soat uchda keling.
